candidates.name: Malignant Melanoma of the Caruncle
support_spans: an amelanotic, pedunculated mass with an ulcerated surface, arising from the caruncle
Revealed a solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface, composed of large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
Showed positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
candidates.why: The patient's presentation and histopathology results are consistent with a diagnosis of malignant melanoma of the caruncle
